==Description==
'''Comeback''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|1,250}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/51636134/profile AltiWyre]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Gallery==
{{Gallery|
{{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}}
<gallery>
Comeback.gif|First version (9 November 2019 – 29 October 2020)
</gallery>
}}

==Trivia==
*This emote is known for its ability of making you glitch through walls.
**You can take advantage of this, as it can let you go to places that you are not allowed to go, such as [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] [[Elevators]].
*Although you cannot move your character while performing this emote, your character actually move a little bit after each turn.
